turns.text: Your supplier has not delivered the tracking module. When were you planning to tell me?
We hit a snag with the supplier and are looking at options. I will update you when I know more.
Options is not a plan. Give me a date and tell me what it costs me.
I should have escalated on Monday. The supplier now commits to 9 June. We will cover the extra four days of testing ourselves, and I will send you a status every Friday until it ships.
Fine. But what is different this time, so I am not here again in a month?

strengths: Gave a specific date and said who pays
gaps: No change offered to avoid a repeat
